text_markup: The Runner encounters {card:Marker}, and its subroutine resolves. The next ice the Runner encounters is {card:Brainstorm}. When the encounter begins, the lingering effect from {card:Marker} gives {card:Brainstorm} an "[sub] End the run." subroutine. Then, {card:Brainstorm}'s conditional ability resolves, giving it the appropriate number of "[sub] Do 1 core damage." subroutines. The "[sub] Do 1 core damage." subroutines are all ordered after the "[sub] End the run." subroutine.
